theme: Which pure materials make this mixed pixel
title: No Pure Pixels: Inflating to the Enclosing Material Simplex
strategies: degenerate baseline: declare every endmember equal to the mean pixel spectrum and give every pixel uniform abundance 1/K

vertex-selection greedy (N-FINDR / pixel-purity style): PCA-project the pixels, greedily pick the K observed pixels spanning maximum simplex volume, declare THOSE PIXELS THEMSELVES the endmembers, fit abundances by nonnegative least squares -- systematically undershoots when no pixel is pure

minimum-enclosing-simplex via facet extrapolation: fit a total-least-squares line through the boundary-hugging points along each simplex EDGE (two-material mixtures, still densely sampled even with no pure pixel), then intersect consecutive edge-lines -- recovers vertices OUTSIDE the observed data cloud
brute-force grid/random search over candidate endmember spectra scored by reconstruction error alone, ignoring the simplex-containment structure entirely
